Source: Faith and Fire, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

This derangement leads sufferers to believe they are granted insight into the divine through visions, trances, and other ecstatic states. During these spells they may be catatonic, in a trancelike state, or raving uncontrollably; their ability to recall details of the visions varies, sometimes recalling precise details, sometimes only vague impressions that surface later in response to some external stimulus. These visions could be products of an overactive imagination, or - at the Storyteller's discretion, and very rarely - a real insight into the unknown.
